layout.hierarchy: Title is largest and dark red. The four boxed diagrams are the main visual mass; colored table cells and circles draw attention next. Equations and footnotes are smaller supporting text.

visual_elements.description: Generic confusion matrix. Header 'Predicted as' over columns P and N; row label 'Actual' beside rows P and N. Cells: Actual P/Predicted P = TP in green, Actual P/Predicted N = FN in light red, Actual N/Predicted P = FP in light red, Actual N/Predicted N = TN in green. Blue outline.
Second generic confusion matrix identical to the top-left one. To the right: 'Total Positive = TP+FN' and 'Total Negative = FP+TN' in red.

Radar shooting tree. Red-outlined box split into 'Positive' on the left and 'Negative' on the right. Left: enemy airplane icon above a red circle labeled 30; dashed arrows from 30 down to a green circle labeled 18 and a red circle labeled 12. Right: green airplane icon above a green circle labeled 70; dashed arrows from 70 down to a green circle labeled 60 and a red circle labeled 10. A dashed horizontal line separates 'Actual' above from 'Predicted' below.

Numeric confusion matrix. Header 'Predicted as' over P and N; row label 'Actual' beside P and N. Cells: Actual P/Predicted P = 18 in green, Actual P/Predicted N = 12 in light red, Actual N/Predicted P = 10 in light red, Actual N/Predicted N = 60 in green. To the right: 'Total Positive = 18+12=30' and 'Total Negative = 10+60=70' in red. Blue outline.
Two airplane icons: left enemy plane with skull-like marking under 'Positive'; right green plane under 'Negative'.

imagery: Left airplane icon depicting an enemy/target plane, gray/dark with a skull-like motif, sits above the red 30 circle in the Positive section.
Right airplane icon depicting a green plane, sits above the green 70 circle in the Negative section.
typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout. Title is bold and larger, dark red with 'Positive' in brighter red. Table headers and cell labels are bold; 'Actual' is rotated vertical and red. Equations are red; footnote lines are black. Slide number is black inside a yellow circle.

recreation_brief: 1) Set a white background. 2) Add the title 'Radar Shooting of Positive Target (Enemy plane)' at the top; make it bold dark red (#C00000) and color the word 'Positive' brighter red (#FF0000). 3) Add a small yellow circle (#FFFF00) at the top right with the number 5. 4) Upper left: draw a blue-outlined (#0000FF) box. Inside, put 'Predicted as' above two column headers P and N, and rotated red 'Actual' left of two row headers P and N. Fill a 2x2 grid: TP and TN green (#00B050), FN and FP light red (#FF9999); text black bold. 5) Lower left: repeat the same blue-outlined confusion matrix. To its right add red equations 'Total Positive = TP+FN' and 'Total Negative = FP+TN'. Under the matrix add black lines 'FN = Actually Positive, Miss-classified as Negative' and 'FP = Actually Negative, Miss-classified as Positive'. 6) Upper right: draw a red-outlined (#FF0000) box. Put 'Positive' in red on the left and 'Negative' in green on the right. Under 'Positive', place the enemy airplane icon, then a red circle '30'; draw dashed arrows to a green circle '18' and a red circle '12'. Under 'Negative', place the green airplane icon, then a green circle '70'; draw dashed arrows to a green circle '60' and a red circle '10'. Add a dashed horizontal divider with 'Actual' above it and 'Predicted' below it on the left. 7) Lower right: draw a blue-outlined numeric confusion matrix with the same P/N headers and Actual label; fill cells 18 and 60 green (#00B050), 12 and 10 light red (#FF9999). To the right add red equations 'Total Positive = 18+12=30' and 'Total Negative = 10+60=70'. 8) Keep all text sans-serif, bold for labels/cells, and align the left column matrices and right column diagrams as described.
